name: Servanthood
overview: Scripture reveals that true greatness in the kingdom of God is defined not by exercising authority over others, but by humble servanthood, as Jesus taught His disciples that those who desire to be first must become the servant of all (Mark 9:35; Matthew 20:25; Mark 10:42). Christ Himself exemplified this servant leadership by coming not to be served but to serve and to give His life as a ransom for many (Mark 10:45). Believers are called to follow Jesus in this path of service, assured that those who serve Him will be honored by the Father (John 12:26), and that serving others is the mark of true fellowship with Christ (Luke 22:27).
